deck.summary: One shared, pre-dealt sequence of 100 event codes (Data->Events[0..99]) is built at game start; there is no reshuffle and no per-turn draw. Each player consumes one slot per season: slot = 2 * (2 * (Year - 57) + Season) + player (player 0 = USA, 1 = USSR; swapped under MAIL_INVERTED). So the USA always reads even slots and the USSR odd slots, and a given code can appear only once in the whole game, for one side only.
deck.text_index_mapping: Events[] holds a code 0..113; the newscast shows events.json text[code + 2] (OpenNews uses event[bud + 2]). events.json index 0 and 1 are the intro/outro lines. This file's 'index' is the events.json index; 'event_code' = index - 2.

build.slots_0_1: fixed to code 0 (opening card) for both players' first turn, Spring 1957
build.pool_choice: For each slot roll r = rand(0..99) and take the first pool whose cumulative percentage is > r; if that pool is empty, roll again. Then remove a uniformly random card from that pool into the slot (draw without replacement).
build.unused: Pool 0 keeps one card forever (3 cards, 2 drawn, 0% afterwards). The game ends after Fall 1977 = slot 83, so slots 84-99 are dealt but never read.
build.difficulty_gating: None. Neither the deal nor REvent looks at the difficulty level.
build.ai: The AI side consumes its slot the same way (AIEvent -> ResolveEvent -> REvent, news.cpp:790-802); it just does not show the broadcast.

draw_each_turn.order: News(plr) runs at the start of each player's turn, before crew/safety checks, damage-repair prompts and the turn itself (game_main.cpp:608-618), so this season's R&D mods, half-price sale, scrubs and delays apply to the turn being played.
steps: REvent: Budget floored at 40, then the ntable budget drift (spec section 4) is applied unconditionally.
Year gates: the card is a 'bad card' (no effect) if Year <= 60 and code > 44, Year <= 62 and code > 63, or Year <= 65 and code > 80. These bite in 1962 (pool 3 opens) and 1965 (pool 4 opens).
The switch on the code applies the effect. A card whose precondition fails (nothing owned, nothing scheduled, nobody alive, etc.) returns 1 = bad card.

ResolveEvent: on a bad card pick a filler slot 1..14 at random that is not yet set in BadCardEventFlag[0..13] (after 30 failed tries the flag array is cleared); set the flag; GoNews then overwrites Events[slot] with 99 + slot so the newscast shows filler text[101 + slot] (events.json index 102-115) and the save file remembers it.
The broadcast is built: intro, card text with placeholders resolved, astronaut news, the seasonal 'also in the news' item, outro.
draw_each_turn.bad_card_flag: BadCardEventFlag[15] is only used to avoid repeating filler texts; it never changes which deck card is drawn.
draw_each_turn.forcing_or_skipping: No code path lets a player force, skip or redraw a card. The replay-after-autosave logic (eCount vs turn) just re-displays the stored text.
draw_each_turn.placeholders: a/d/f/i/j = evflag as a number; b = FIRST/SECOND/THIRD from evflag (pad index); h = PRIMARY/SECONDARY/THIRD; c/e = Name (program or astronaut); g = president/premier by year; m = player name (news.cpp:321-421).

deck.one_shot: Every deck card is one-shot by construction (dealt without replacement into a single shared sequence). Flags a card sets are never reset by the deck: SaveCard is consumed by the next saved failure; Damage/DCost by repair or the next mission; Delay counts down; RD_Mods_For_Turn and TurnOnly are zeroed each season; UnitCost/RDCost/MaxSafety changes are permanent.
deck.usa_vs_ussr: The same code has the same effect for both sides (the texts differ). The only side-dependent lines are the retirement cards (49, 89: USSR retires immediately, USA announces with RetirementDelay 2) and the fixed names/stats of the three bonus astronauts (57).

effect_vocabulary.none: No game effect; the newscast line is flavour only.
effect_vocabulary.unimplemented: The card text promises an effect but the upstream code applies nothing (flag never read, or the code is commented out).
effect_vocabulary.cash_delta: Cash on hand (P.Cash) changes by params.amount (fixed) or params.dice (rolled).
effect_vocabulary.cash_pct: Cash on hand loses floor(Cash * params.pct / 100); skipped (bad card) below params.min_cash.
effect_vocabulary.budget_delta: Next season's budget (P.Budget) changes by params.amount or params.dice.
effect_vocabulary.rd_mod_turn: RD_Mods_For_Turn += params.amount: every R&D team this season rolls 1d(6 + mod).
effect_vocabulary.rd_mod_year: Text says a whole year; code sets RD_Mods_For_Turn and RD_Mods_For_Year, but start.cpp:730 only carries POSITIVE year mods forward, so in practice it is this season only (params.seasons_actual).
effect_vocabulary.rd_cost_up: RDCost += params.amount permanently on the most advanced owned program (highest equipment index with Safety > Base).
effect_vocabulary.tech_steal: Pick a random program both players own where the rival's Safety is higher; our Safety rises by the gap (to equal the rival's).
effect_vocabulary.tech_leak: Pick a random program both players own where the rival's Safety is higher; our Safety falls by the gap (2*ours - rival's), programs that would drop below Base are not candidates.
effect_vocabulary.program_safety_delta: Safety of the most advanced owned program in params.group changes by params.amount or params.dice (absolute points, capped at MaxSafety).
effect_vocabulary.program_safety_halved: Safety of the most advanced owned rocket with Safety > 50 loses floor(Safety/2).
effect_vocabulary.program_max_safety_up: MaxRD and MaxSafety of every program in params.group rise by params.amount (MaxSafety capped at 99, MaxRD capped at MaxSafety).
effect_vocabulary.program_delay: Equipment.Delay = params.seasons on every program in params.group: no purchases (InitCost or units) until it counts down (one per end-of-season).
effect_vocabulary.program_unit_cost_up: UnitCost += params.amount permanently on params.program, only if that program is owned.
effect_vocabulary.pay_or_penalty: Most advanced owned program in params.group with Safety > Base gets Damage += params.safety_penalty and DCost += params.cost. The player may pay DCost (prompted at turn start if affordable, or via the F key in R&D/purchase) to clear it; otherwise the next mission using that hardware runs at Safety + Damage and the damage is cleared after that mission.
effect_vocabulary.save_card: SaveCard = 1 on the most advanced owned program in params.group: the next failed step on that hardware is converted into a success and the card is consumed.
effect_vocabulary.half_price_sale: TurnOnly = 3: this season InitCost and UnitCost of all hardware are halved (min 1, items already free stay free).
effect_vocabulary.mission_scrub: A scheduled mission this season is scrubbed (hardware returned, crews unassigned). Joint missions scrub both halves.
effect_vocabulary.mission_delay: A scheduled mission is moved from this season's pad to next season's future slot on the same pad (overwriting any planned future mission there); hardware returns to inventory, crews stay attached.
effect_vocabulary.mission_crew_swap: The primary crew is removed from the first scheduled mission that has one; the backup crew (if any) becomes the flight crew. With no backup the mission is scrubbed at launch (MissionCrewCantFly).
effect_vocabulary.pad_damage: LaunchFacility[pad] = params.repair_cost: the pad is unusable until the player pays that many MB to repair it.
effect_vocabulary.astronaut_death: A random astronaut who is not dead or retired (trainees and injured included) dies; MissionCatastrophicFailureOnTurn |= 2 so every astronaut loses 1-2 mood at season end; any crew containing them is broken up.
effect_vocabulary.astronaut_injury: A random astronaut who is not dead or retired becomes Injured for params.seasons seasons (endurance can shorten/lengthen it); crews containing them are broken up.
effect_vocabulary.astronaut_retire: A random astronaut from params.candidates announces retirement: RetirementDelay = 2 (USA, retires after two end-of-season updates, cannot be newly assigned meanwhile); the USSR astronaut is retired immediately.
effect_vocabulary.astronaut_recruit: Three fixed bonus astronauts join the pool in basic training at no cost.
effect_vocabulary.female_astronauts: FemaleAstronautsAllowed = 1: the next recruitment pulls from the mixed roster (and must include at least one woman for AstroLevel 0-2).
